topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Well now, I heard the miller's son was craftin' somethin' mighty clever, a contraption to help with the grindin'. He worked at it right through the winter, barely stoppin' for a mouthful of bread. When he took it to the town, thinkin' to show it to the marketplace, he found out there was already a like-minded soul in another part of the land. This other feller had the same notions as him and already had the king's mark on it, or so they say. I reckon the miller's lad took it hard, workin' so long and findin' out his idea wasn’t as new as he thought. But life teaches us hard lessons, and maybe this one will lead him to somethin' even better. We’ll see what the seasons bring.
